data.long_meaning: Rameshwer is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Rama and Ishwer. Rama means 'God' or 'Dharma' and Ishwer means 'God'. Thus, Rameshwer means 'God of Rama'. The name Rameshwer carries the meaning “God of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rameshwer usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
